onset: 2026-03-17T09:23:00.000Z
The error_rate metric shows a dramatic increase starting at 09:23:00 from 0.0024 to 0.1255, indicating the onset of the incident (metrics/http.csv:25). The p95 latency also rises sharply from 162.94 to over 190 ms and continues increasing, confirming performance degradation (metrics/http.csv:25-61). The p50 latency and RPS remain relatively stable, indicating that the volume of requests and median latency were not the primary factors (metrics/http.csv:1-61). This suggests a sudden spike in errors and tail latency rather than load or median latency issues. The alerts for CheckoutErrorRateHigh and ApiLatencyP95 start shortly after the error rate spike, at 09:27 and 09:31 respectively (alerts.jsonl:1-2). The last deploy before the incident was at 09:22 with summary 'checkout: add tiered discount support' (changes.jsonl:2), which may be related.
